jobs.title: Automotive Finance Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking to hire a Finance Manager at our dealership in Birmingham, AL.
The Finance Coach ensures that the dealership meets its performance targets by selecting, securing, and offering the best financial products to ensure strong profit performance and guest satisfaction. The ideal candidate has strong financial literacy, works well in a very fast-paced and high-volume environment, and can coach teammates to maximize profitability and guest experience.
What You'll Do:
- Drive profitability through timely, accurate, and compliant financial performance.
- Forecast monthly with each salesperson to establish objectives in terms of the number and type of customers coming into the dealership, closing percentages in each category, time utilization, prospecting efforts, unit sales, and projected income.
- Partner and coach salespeople to maximize opportunity.
- Conduct sales meetings.
- Provide on-the-job training for salespeople.
- Review monthly commission sheets, productivity reports, salespersons’ monthly forecasts, and profit performance with the Dealer by salesperson and as a department.
- Ensure legal, financial, and other pertinent paperwork is both accurate, timely, and organized.

What We're Looking For:
- Strong automotive sales and finance experience
- Experience in a dealership management position
- Be transparent
- Take the high road
- Willingness to learn
- Take ownership
- Celebrate small successes

What You'll Get:
- Average annual income potential of $80- 102k
- Health, Dental and Vision Insurance
- 401k with 4% company match
- Paid vacation
- Access to leadership and personal development programs
- Casual dress code

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Brand Manager Job Summary:

The Brand Manager is responsible for developing sustainable brand and store growth for individual OEM Brand(s) by driving a best-in-class marketing strategy focused on increasing new and used vehicle sales, service, market share, establishing a store’s brand, and improving brand loyalty. The Brand Manager will build strong relationships with senior manufacturer marketing partners and work with internal cross-functional subject matter experts in the development of all brand initiatives by providing strategic insight and brand/store analysis. The role will identify specific brand needs and competitive actions, including brand positioning, market needs, target audiences, and competitive and consumer insights. The Brand Manager will be the main contact for all OEM marketing partners and internal teams regarding brand marketing direction for all stores within their brand(s).
In this role, the Brand Manager will also be accountable for achieving all OEM Brand goals as well as accelerating performance to be  a market leader for the brand. This role will be involved in overseeing daily marketing performance and understanding operational performance related to brand, marketing, and competitive initiatives. To accomplish this, the role will work closely with the Brand Vice President, Sonic Marketing team, General Managers, and other business units to collaborate and execute all brand-related initiatives.
The Brand Manager reports directly to the VP Brand Strategy, who oversees marketing operational consistency and aligns all Brand Manager needs based on company goals and priorities.
Brand Manager Responsibilities Include:
Core 5:
1. Manufacturer Relationships

Establish, nurture, and own high-impact relationships with OEM senior marketing personnel, starting with CMO or VP of Marketing positions. Serve as the key strategist between the OEM’s approach and store-level execution, ensuring alignment across Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 marketing initiatives, leveraging the OEM’s needs, focus, and marketing spend with ours. Actively engage in Local Marketing Associations (e.g., LMA, DMA, DMG, etc.) while driving influence to be on their board and/or how they spend marketing ad dollars.  Maintaining a deep understanding of OEM objectives, scorecards, and KPIs. Lead performance assessments and manage participation in OEM co-op and special incentive programs, leveraging them to the fullest.
2. Market Share Growth

Drive market share growth across all stores by identifying local opportunities and developing targeted marketing strategies. Conduct in-depth assessments of store performance, competitive activity, community presence, OEM benchmarks, and inventory to inform strategic plans. Partner with cross-functional teams to implement initiatives that deliver measurable growth.
3. Pre-Owned Performance

Support each store’s contribution to the company-wide goal of averaging 100 pre-owned units per month. Lead the development and execution of high-converting used vehicle marketing strategies. Collaborate with used vehicle directors and traffic managers to optimize inventory exposure, maximizing merchandising, digital presence, and customer targeting.
4. Fixed Operations Focus

Grow service lane traffic by increasing the percentage of Sonic cars within our markets Units in Operation (UIO). Lead the development and execution of high-converting fixed operations marketing strategies.  Leverage Sonic and OEM customer databases and overall performance data to identify fixed ops opportunities and monitor progress. Work with service managers to enhance customer retention, drive repair order volume, and position Fixed Ops as a key profit center.
5. Brand Ownership & Experience

Own and execute the brand vision and identity, ensuring consistent messaging and visual standards across all touchpoints. Champion a cohesive brand identity that reflects both the store, the manufacturer, and Sonic brand values. Oversee store presentation, team culture, store reputation, and customer engagement to deliver a best-in-class experience and execute on the Sonic pride playbook. Providing guidance and insights related to the brand and each individual store to personalize and differentiate our dealerships from one another and our competitors.
